description: Voids a prediction with a reason, only on a day strictly BEFORE its `date` (afterwards it is scored whatever the caller now thinks). It stays in the ledger with the reason and is never scored; get_prediction_stats counts voided ones apart, so voiding cannot hide one. A scored prediction cannot be voided. Voiding twice returns the first void. Local file only. Destructive: a void cannot be undone.
name: void_prediction
title: Void a prediction before its date (kept, with the reason; cannot be undone)
